events.title: CNBLUE 2027 Live at KSPO Dome
events.summary: CNBLUE are confirmed for a two-night solo concert at KSPO Dome on February 20–21, 2027, marking the band’s first standalone KSPO Dome run after 17 years.

events.title: Freya Skye - Stars Align Tour in Seoul
events.summary: Freya Skye brings the Stars Align Tour to Seoul for a February 20, 2027 headline show at Myunghwa Live Hall, with tickets sold via NOL.
